dogecoin.text: Robinhood supported "Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Bitcoin SV, Dogecoin, Ethereum, Ethereum Classic and Litecoin". What on Earth is Bitcoin SV? 😂

Aha! DOGE! Robinhood S-1 $HOOD: "While we currently support a portfolio of seven cryptocurrencies for trading, for the three months ended June 30, 2021, 62% of our cryptocurrency transaction-based revenue was attributable to transactions in Dogecoin."

Thank you, @Dilnewm 🙏🏻
